title: Governor, Reserve Bank of India meets Representatives of Export Organisations in Mumbai on June 25, 2026
description: Governor, Reserve Bank of India, Shri Sanjay Malhotra today met in Mumbai with representatives of various Export Federations, Export Promotion Councils, Export Committee of Confederation of Indian Industry and Foreign Exchange Dealers’ Association of India. The meeting was also attended by Deputy Governors Shri Swaminathan J., Dr. Poonam Gupta and Shri Rohit Jain and other senior officers of Reserve Bank of India.
